review.root: Reviewed plan and production code; required strict actual-level reporting, queue closure around PM/unbind, and safe access to uninitialized policies on other boards. All fixed. Found and fixed test device cleanup ordering.
review.grok: Independent read-only review clears 44fe00e5 production driver; addendum clears 4b318c41 test allocation lifetime fix. No hardware claim.
review.claude: Implemented the port and executed the KUnit, W=1 and KASAN runs.

kasan_debug_spinlock.regression_proof: The original 44fe00e5 fixture triggers KASAN use-after-free in dcp_backlight_release; corrected 4b318c41 passes.

known_limits: No hardware result follows from KUnit or source review.
The requested 140-nit placeholder is not a measured bootloader level.
Resume opens the worker gate; a pending level is sent on the next frame or kick.
A first surface-less blank can complete a pending positive level before a level was previously known.
An internal display RPC failure retains the existing fail-until-reboot policy.
Other boards and firmware need their own hardware qualification.
loader_contract: The existing loader artifact and J516S DTB are reused unchanged. Its source manifest records the earlier kernel validation pin; this release records the new kernel pairing and hardware result without changing loader code.
